name: Human Archive (HA-Ego)
tagline: ~500 h of chest-mounted 1080p video of real work in 181 environments (10,633 segments, 5,562 people) with AI task labels; sample repo gone.

annotations.format: JSON metadata per segment (HA-Ego-Samples); Ego500 successor ships JSON step annotations
annotations.coverageNote: HA-Ego-Samples (scored here) had Gemini task/environment labels per segment. Its repo is gone; Ego500 ('HA-Ego-500', gated, upload pending) adds 310K steps.

narrations.note: None in HA-Ego-Samples; Ego500 adds per-step imperative descriptions

action_labels.note: Task (753) + environment (181) label per segment, Gemini-assigned

qa_language.note: Ego500 adds per-hand state + visible-object lists per step

annotations.sample:
